methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops initiated by a Norfolk native represent grassroots capability-building outside traditional tech hubs, signaling potential for distributed peer-to-peer learning networks that could democratize AI fluency beyond NoVA.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab launching workforce training demonstrates institutional capacity-building in a mid-tier market, testing whether deep AI fluency can take root in regions beyond the NoVA-Richmond corridor through educational anchors.

signals.title: New Jersey, Virginia Can Lead the Nation By Building ‘AI Resilience Cohorts’ to Develop Early-Career, State Talent Pipelines - Federation of American Scientists
signals.signal_reading: The proposed 'AI Resilience Cohorts' model explicitly targets distributed state talent pipelines rather than concentrating in existing tech centers, representing a policy intervention designed to counteract the natural gravity toward Pockets of Excellence.

signals.title: In the data center capital of the world, residents ask who the AI boom is helping - NBC News
signals.signal_reading: Residents questioning who benefits from NoVA's data center boom reveals that infrastructure concentration doesn't automatically translate to distributed capability or community benefit, signaling risk of shallow engagement even in the epicenter.

signals.title: Virginia Tech Team Builds AI Tool to Referee Water Rivalry Between Farms and Chip Factories - theroanokestar.com
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech developing specialized AI tools for resource allocation represents deep technical capability concentrating around research universities, reinforcing the pattern where institutional anchors create localized excellence pockets rather than distributed fluency.
